support_evidence.source: registered observed substrate; conflicts and unobserved cells excluded

edge_anchor_evidence.reason: Fewer than three observed coherent edge images.

coverage_note: Every planned field intersecting the conservative enclosure polygon is acquired. Planned-area coverage and evidence validating the estimated chip extent are reported separately.

focus_policy.plane: At least four measured points; every residual within its limit. Bounded extrapolation assumes a planar chip.
focus_policy.outside_hull: Accept a bounded measured-plane prediction only within distance and conditional uncertainty limits; otherwise autofocus an image-supported ROI.
